title: Vitrine Jar Series
description: Four reference-linked fermentation vessels photographed like museum specimens with layered biological texture.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the vitrine light, glass-reflection discipline, and specimen pedestal language. Images 02-04 preserve that exact archival system while rotating among kombucha, kimchi, and miso structures.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-vitrine-jar-anchor first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for the remaining series images. Queue may run the dependent variations concurrently after the reference is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
